thread:
jamie: Heads-up: promoting search-indexer v3.0.1 which bumps a dependency subchart (index-lib) from 1.2.0 -> 1.3.0. Canaries OK but we saw a partial schema migration in the configmap that the subchart expects (new key `enable_sparse_index`). Holding before full rollout.

ravi: The migration only adds an optional flag defaulting to false. But overlay for high-throughput clusters set `enable_sparse_index: true` implicitly by relying on absent keys. If the new default is false, those clusters may degrade indexing throughput.

deploy-bot: Canary 1 (us-west-2a) -> PASS. Post-check: indexing throughput on 2/3 pods down ~15%. Alerts: indexing-latency > 200ms.

jamie: We should either patch overlays to include `enable_sparse_index: true` for affected clusters or roll the canary back. Which is faster?

release-lead: Change window til 01:30 UTC. Quick patch to overlays is fastest. We must also update the release notes to mention migration behavior. Recommend patch + resume.

ci-bot: Note: promotion job recorded subchart version bump. It did not surface config keys diff to overlays. CI enhancement: diff subchart transitive keys vs overlays. Filing ticket DEP-67.

ravi: I'll push overlay patch to chart repo for all high-throughput overlays. Command: `git commit -m "indexer: set enable_sparse_index for high-throughput overlays"` then `helm repo index`.

jamie: Pausing promotion. deploy-bot: promotion paused by jamie at 3467919999.

ravi: Patch pushed and PR opened: https://go/pull/patch-indexer-enable-sparse. K8s hotpatch option: `kubectl -n prod set env deployment/search-indexer ENABLE_SPARSE_INDEX=true` but that won't persist for future promotions. Better to fix overlays.

deploy-bot: Edge cluster deployments receiving patch? Noted only high-throughput overlay namespaces updated.

ravi: PR merged. Rebuilt chart index. Pushing helm index updates now.

deploy-bot: Preflight verification: overlays contain `enable_sparse_index: true` for clusters: high-throughput-us, high-throughput-eu.

jamie: Resume promotion at 3467920040. deploy-bot: Wave 2 starting.

deploy-bot: Wave 2 -> PASS. Post-checks: indexing throughput returned to expected on sampled pods.

release-lead: Action items: ravi -> backfill overlays in chart repo and add unit test to validate presence of `enable_sparse_index` for high-throughput overlays; jamie -> update release notes with migration note and affected clusters; ci-bot -> DEP-67 to add subchart-key-diff to preflight.

jamie: Release note snippet: "search-indexer v3.0.1 upgrades index-lib v1.3.0 which introduces optional `enable_sparse_index` defaulting to false. High-throughput overlays should set this to true. Promotion paused briefly to backfill overlays." Link: https://go/release-notes/search-indexer/3.0.1-draft

ravi: All good. Marking resolved.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. artifacts: helm-chart search-indexer-3.0.1.tgz, promotion-log: https://go/promote/3467919999/log

jamie: thanks everyone. Closing thread after DEP-67 tracked.
